patch_list: Pure AMOLED Black Theme - Fossify Phone (Experimental)
Applies a pure #000000 AMOLED dark theme across dialpad, in-call screen, contacts list, and call history for optimal OLED battery savings.
Silent & Unrestricted Call Recording - Fossify Phone (Experimental)
Unlocks call recording across all regions/devices, suppresses carrier/recording warning beeps and disclosure alerts, and automatically enables two-way audio recording directly to local storage.
